title: Northwind SaaS × Tessera Dental Group: quarterly check-in
transcript:
Jonas: How's it going after the first three months?
Sofia: Mostly good. Most of the front desk team uses the saved replies now. Patients get answers the same day.
Sofia: Two problems. We're opening two new clinics in December, so twelve new people need training.
Jonas: I'll run a training session for the new clinic staff. Let's do it before the 18th of November so they're ready.
Sofia: Perfect. The second thing is reporting. I need a monthly export for the board and it only exports to PDF.
Jonas: I'll log a feature request for a CSV export and tell you what the product team says.
Sofia: Also the single sign-on sometimes logs people out.
Jonas: Emma from our support team will fix the single sign-on bug this week.
Sofia: Thanks. Same time next quarter?
Jonas: Yes, I'll send an invite.
